marketing.tagline: Fixed spots, class packs and a waitlist in one system.
marketing.subtitle: Booking and management software for studios. Every student place is held week after week, and cancellations fill themselves.
marketing.trialNote: One month free, no card. A flat price per studio.
marketing.pain1: The timetable lives in a spreadsheet.
marketing.pain3: The place that opened up stays empty.
marketing.pain4: Each instructor hours are worked out by hand.
marketing.modelsTitle: Two ways to attend. Both accounted for.
marketing.modelsBody: Most systems account for only one.
marketing.modelFixedBody: The same day and hour every week. Assigned once, then held.
marketing.modelFixedRule: Given notice, the student has a set number of changes per month and recovers the class. Past that limit it is forfeited.
marketing.modelPackBody: The student buys a pack and books around their availability.
marketing.modelPackRule: Each pack has a price and an expiry. When a class is full, the student joins the waitlist.
marketing.waitTitle: A cancellation is filled again without intervention.
marketing.waitBody: Classes that used to run with empty places fill on their own.
marketing.waitStep2Title: The first in line is notified
marketing.waitStep2Body: They have a window to confirm.
marketing.waitStep3Body: With no action from the studio.
marketing.cap1Body: Set up once, repeated week after week.
marketing.cap2Body: Transfers with a receipt, or Mercado Pago.
marketing.cap3Body: Classes, hours and amount per instructor. Exportable.
marketing.cap7Body: Your logo and colour, on every plan.
marketing.cap8Body: Installs without going through a store.
marketing.priceBody: No per-student fee. The invoice does not rise as enrolment grows.
marketing.migrationBody: Send us your spreadsheet and the system comes back configured.
marketing.faq1Q: Does the price rise with the number of students?
marketing.faq1A: No. The price is per studio.
marketing.faq2Q: What about students who are not comfortable with apps?
marketing.faq2A: They sign in with an ID number, or the studio books on their behalf.
marketing.faq3Q: Can the studio keep taking bank transfers?
marketing.faq3A: Yes. The student sends a receipt and the studio approves it. Mercado Pago is optional.
marketing.faq4Q: What happens when the trial ends?
marketing.faq4A: The information is kept and can be exported. Nothing is charged without a plan.
marketing.faq5A: The studio. It can be downloaded at any time.
marketing.closingBody: No card, no commitment. Initial setup can be handled by our team.
marketing.whatsappMessage: Hello. I would like to know more about TEMPPO Reservas for my studio.

welcomeStaff.title: Welcome to TEMPPO!
welcomeStaff.body: Let us get your studio running. First we set it up step by step, then I will show you the day to day. Leave whenever you like and pick up where you left off.

studio.title: Your studio
studio.body: Name, logo and brand colour, plus timezone and currency. Everything your students see comes from here: the app, the emails and your booking page.

rules.title: Your rules
rules.body: How many hours ahead someone can cancel, how far ahead booking opens, and how many changes a month a fixed spot gets. Set once and left alone.

locations.title: Your locations
locations.body: If you run more than one place, add them here and each keeps its own schedule, classes and students. With a single location you are already set.

teachers.title: Your teachers
teachers.body: They come before classes, because every class is assigned to one. Each gets an email with a temporary password and sees only their own schedule. Teaching yourself? Add yourself too.

packs.title: Your packs
packs.body: This is what students buy: 4, 8 or 12 classes, with a price and an expiry. Until one pack exists, nobody can buy or book on their own.

classes.title: Your classes
classes.body: This is the timetable: name, days, time, length, capacity and teacher. A class that runs Monday, Wednesday and Friday is entered once and repeats itself every week.

students.title: Your students
students.body: Add them with a name and an email. Each gets a temporary password to sign in and change. They can also sign themselves up from your booking page.

spots.title: Fixed spots
spots.body: If someone always comes at the same hour, give them the spot and it is held every week without them booking. Everyone else buys packs and picks as they go.

panel.title: Your dashboard
panel.body: What is happening today: the next class with its spots, and whatever needs you, like pending payments.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.body: Every class this week. Tap one to see who is coming, add someone by hand or take attendance.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.body: Scan the student QR code as they arrive and attendance is recorded instantly.

spotsDaily.title: Fixed spots
spotsDaily.body: Who holds a place every week. One glance shows which hours still have room, without opening a spreadsheet.

more.title: Everything else
more.body: In here you will find Students, Classes, Leads, Packs, Payments, Reports and Settings. You also sign out from this menu.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Who has paid and who owes. Transfer receipts land here and you approve them one by one, instead of digging through a chat.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Attendance, the month income and what each teacher is owed. All of it exports, if your accountant needs it.

done.title: All set
done.body: Everything is in place. If you want to go over something again, the tour is saved in the More menu.

welcomeStudent.title: Hi there!
welcomeStudent.body: A quick look at how to book your classes.

myClasses.title: My classes
myClasses.body: Your upcoming classes and the QR code to get into the studio. You cancel from here too.

book.title: Book
book.body: Pick a day and a time. If the class is full you join the waitlist and we let you know when a place opens up.

buy.title: Buy
buy.body: Class packs. Pay online or by transfer, sending the receipt.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Turn on notifications for your classes and for when a place frees up. You also sign out here.

doneStudent.title: Off you go!
doneStudent.body: That is it. Book your first class whenever you like.
